import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
REL_NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("Archive members:", z.namelist())

    # Workbook sheet list
    wb_xml = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = []
    for sh in wb_xml.iter(NS + "sheet"):
        sheets.append((sh.get("name"), sh.get("sheetId"), sh.get("r:id")))
    print("Sheets:", sheets)

    # Shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss.iter(NS + "si"):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(NS + "t"))
            shared.append(text)

    # Relationships to map sheet names
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {}
    for rel in rels:
        rel_map[rel.get("Id")] = rel.get("Target")

    for name, sheet_id, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map.get(rid, "")
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        print(f"\n=== Sheet '{name}' ({target}) ===")
        ws = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in ws.iter(NS + "row"):
            vals = []
            for c in row.iter(NS + "c"):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find(NS + "v")
                if t == "s" and v is not None:
                    idx = int(v.text)
                    val = shared[idx] if idx < len(shared) else None
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                else:
                    val = c.find(NS + "is")
                    if val is not None:
                        val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in val.iter(NS + "t"))
                    else:
                        val = None
                vals.append(f"{ref}={val!r}")
            print(vals)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

path = "budget.xlsx"
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    raw = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
    # Show raw XML for rows 8, 23, 25 to inspect formulas vs values
    import re
    ws = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    expense_rows = []
    for row in ws.iter(NS + "row"):
        r = int(row.get("r"))
        if 11 <= r <= 22:
            cells = {}
            for c in row.iter(NS + "c"):
                v = c.find(NS + "v")
                cells[c.get("r")] = (c.get("t"), v.text if v is not None else None, c.find(NS + "f"))
            expense_rows.append((r, cells))
    total = 0
    for r, cells in expense_rows:
        t, val, f = cells.get(f"C{r}", (None, None, None))
        amount = float(val) if val is not None else 0.0
        is_formula = f is not None
        total += amount
        print(f"Row {r}: amount={amount} formula={is_formula}")
    print(f"\nSUM of expenses (C11:C22) = {total}")

    # Check formulas present in workbook
    for ref in ("C23", "B8", "B25"):
        m = re.search(rf'<c r="{ref}"[^>]*>.*?</c>', raw, re.S)
        print(f"\nRaw XML {ref}: {m.group(0) if m else 'not found'}")
